info.title: dacdeploy
info.description: Plans and applies a SQL Server database project (.sqlproj) to a database with DacFx: review a saved plan, then apply exactly that plan.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Plans and applies a SQL Server database project to a database: plan shows what applying would change, and apply applies a plan you saved and reviewed, or a fresh one once you've seen it and said yes.

options.name: --out
options.description: Also save the plan, with the SQL it runs, to review and then apply

options.name: --exit-code
options.description: Exit 2 instead of 0 when there are changes [default: False]

options.name: --prune
options.description: Plan to drop what the database has and the project doesn't [default: False]

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Also show what dotnet build and DacFx print [default: False]

commands.name: apply
commands.description: Apply a saved plan (--plan); without one, plan, ask, then apply

options.name: --plan
options.description: A plan saved with plan --out, to apply exactly that plan

options.name: --prune
options.description: Without --plan, also drop what the database has and the project doesn't [default: False]

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Also show what dotnet build and DacFx print [default: False]

commands.name: extract
commands.description: Show how the database's schema differs from the project's Schema/dbo

options.name: --write
options.description: Replace the project's Schema/dbo with it [default: False]

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Also show what dotnet build and DacFx print [default: False]

commands.name: login
commands.description: Save the environment's login in your OS credential store

options.name: --read-only
options.description: Save the read-only login, which plan and extract use when there is one [default: False]

commands.name: environments
commands.description: List the configured environments, and where each is defined
